lines:
Responsibilities: Defines the portable Aworkit-owned schemas and deterministic byte encoding for semantic Chat/Run events, segment headers/trailers, immutable checkpoints, portable frozen snapshots, omission facts, and provenance. It converts only already-scrubbed DTOs and validates decoded records before any semantic consumer sees them.
Owned contracts: PortableSemanticEventV1 carries EventId, ChatId/RunId/SessionId, BranchId, branchOrdinal, aggregateVersion, attempt/correlation identifiers, optional parentEventId, semantic event kind, and sanitized payload. SegmentHeaderV1 carries SegmentHash domain, parentSegmentHash, baseCheckpointHash, firstOrdinal, eventCount, codec/schema versions, and CommitId. PortableCheckpointRecordV1 has a content hash and the last included event/head identities. EventId and CommitId are stable opaque IDs; ordering comes only from parent pointers plus contiguous ordinals, never UUID or wall-clock order.
Serialization and hashes: emits UTF-8, LF-terminated, one canonical JSON object per line using RFC 8785-compatible key/string/number rules, forbids non-finite or ambiguous numeric forms, and domain-separates event, segment, checkpoint, snapshot, and artifact hashes. Hash verification operates over exact stored bytes. Unknown optional fields remain available as opaque canonical bytes; unknown required event/schema versions cannot be applied and yield an inspect-only diagnostic.
Ports/DTOs: CanonicalEventCodecPort encodes/decodes bounded streams; SchemaRegistryPort reports supported versions/features; VerifyPortableRecordPort returns stable JSON-pointer diagnostics without mutating input.
Failure, security, and NFRs: malformed UTF-8/JSON, duplicate keys, oversized lines, ID mismatch, ordinal gaps, native provider/Rig types, or forbidden sensitive variants fail closed. Streaming decode is memory-bounded and deterministic across supported platforms; golden vectors pin every hash and canonical byte sequence.
Non-responsibilities: no export-policy decision, secret scanning substitute, file IO, artifact admission, branch choice/head mutation, side-effect replay, or capability execution.

data.name: Aworkit Semantic Event Codec & Canonical Serializer
data.technology: Rust Aworkit DTO schemas, streaming JSONL codec, RFC 8785 canonical JSON, SHA-256
